E.name: Event Horizon
E.title: Template:Data Veigar/Event Horizon
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Event Horizon|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Veigar
|skill        = E
|icon         = Event Horizon.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} After a brief delay, {{ci|Veigar}} erects a cage at the target location that lasts for a short time. Enemies that touch the cage edges are briefly {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Veigar''' forms a cage at the target location that erects after a {{fd|0.5}} second delay, remaining there for 3 seconds. Enemies that collide with the edges of the cage are {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration.
|description2 = ''Event Horizon'' can affect enemies only once per cast.
|leveling     = {{st|Stun Duration|{{ap|1.5 to 2.5}} seconds}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|20 to 14}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = {{ap|70 to 90}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|costtype     = mana
|target range = 725
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|411|Outer radius}}|{{tt|290|Safe zone radius}}|{{tt|390|Credit marker radius}}}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = 
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* The stun and the knockdown are applied to units that are within a certain distance interval from the center of the area of effect.
* An enemy can be affected by ''Event Horizon'' only once every {{fd|4.5}} seconds.
* Units that negate the stun will still count as passing through the edges. They will become immune to the effects of ''Event Horizon'' for the period even after negating them.
* {{tip|Displacement immune}} enemies will still be {{tip|stun|stunned}}, but not {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}}.
* '''Veigar''' marks enemy {{tip|champions}} in a 390-radius from the zone's center in order to gain [[Kill#Credit|kill/assist credit]], lasting for the standard credit timer.
* ''Event Horizon'' may fail to catch enemies that move very quickly through the boundary distance.
** More modern area checks such as {{cai|The Box|Thresh}} or {{cai|Yordle Snap Trap|Caitlyn}} do not have this issue.
}}
